title: Tadarus in the Holy Land
lead: Umrah while learning and reflecting on the Qur'an where it was revealed — Makkah and Madinah. Three programmes, for three groups of people.

highlights: Tadabbur where the Qur'an was revealed

programs.title: Choose your programme
programs.lead: Each one brings Umrah and learning the Qur'an together — they differ in who joins and what is studied.

ut.text: Umrah while learning tadabbur of the Qur'an, with i'tikaf in the Prophet's Mosque and the Grand Mosque.

ts.text: Qur'an and Arabic lessons in Makkah, with Umrah and the Prophet's footsteps.

dq.text: Training in the skills of tadabbur and Tadarus circles with the an-Naba' al-'Azhim Academy in Makkah.

leaders.title: Why study in Makkah?
leaders.lead: In the words of the leaders of Markaz Tadarus Indonesia

rahmat.text: Markaz Tadarus Indonesia works to spread the values of the Qur'an as widely as possible across Indonesia. The highest aim of it all: that every Muslim can feel the Qur'an for themselves, at every moment.

adnan.text: The Qur'an is a guide for life, full of moral, social and ethical values. Markaz Tadarus Indonesia helps people live with the Qur'an: understanding it, feeling it and living it every day.

agus.text: Makkah has been the heart of Islam since the revelation began. That is what makes this programme special: we study the Qur'an and Arabic in the noblest place, while doing the greatest of deeds.

naba.name: an-Naba' al-'Azhim Foundation
naba.text: Our partner in Makkah: the Duta Qur'an courses and their certificate, and visits to historic places.

hijaz.name: Markaz al-Hijaz
hijaz.text: An institute for the Qur'an and Arabic that runs the Umrah programmes and their lessons with us.
